column1: # The pairs the reading term's syllable normalisation (core/src/reading.rs `ReadingDecode::with_syllable_norm`, docs/spec/decoder.md §5) moves on the
# shipping lexicon: `character TAB reading TAB t`, t after the rule and before the `LAMBDA * max(t, -CAP)` step. 61 rows on 59 syllables, sorted by
# character then reading; every other pair of the dump equals the table before the rule (core/tests/reading_mass.rs).
# Made from the evaluation CLI's reading-table dump (`shanjie-eval --lm data/lm/bigram.sjlm --profile chat --dump-reading-table FILE`): the rows whose t
# differs from the same dump of the build before the rule. tools/reading_norm_probe.py reads the pairs to build eval/dev/reading-norm/context.txt.
